snippet.title: Don't Pull Me | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#indiegame #coop #coopgaming #dontpullme #steam #multiplayer 

Dont Pull Me is a physics-based co-op parkour game for 1 to 4 players. Tied together by a rope, you and your friends must climb, swing, carry objects, and survive chaotic ragdoll disasters without dragging the whole team down.

Steam Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4423110/Dont_Pull_Me/

Available on July 25.

If you like our game and it caught your interest, you can support us by adding it to your wishlist. Thank you 💗
